title: SYN-0025: one recorded moment
description: One recorded moment 24 h into this held-out patient's data (the live app's default start): record, twin state, forecast, glucose profile, FHIR export and every What-If amount. The replay can step once, 5 min, to the end of the recording. Full replays: SYN-0039 and SYN-0019, or any patient in the local app.

genetic_markers.note: synthetic; display-only (no simulated effect, not used by the model)

excursion.event_definition: Onset of a hyperglycaemic excursion (>= 3 consecutive CGM readings > 180 mg/dL, i.e. >= 15 min) within the next 120 min, predicted at times when the latest reading is <= 180 mg/dL.

forecast.disclaimer: Research prototype on synthetic data. Not a medical device. Forecasts are not diagnoses or treatment instructions.

primary.label: vs a zero-carb meal at the same time (isolates the carb content)

secondary.label: vs no meal (also includes the model's learned meal-timing expectation)

notes: Meals under 30 g are unreliable in this model: few training meals are that small and the audited small-meal differences are unstable.
Logging any meal now (even zero-carb) shifts the +60-min forecast by +23.3 mg/dL on its own: a learned meal-timing association, not physiology. That is why the no-meal comparison differs.

joint_support.caveat: Training-support check: it flags meal inputs with no comparable example in the training data. It is not evidence that the forecast is wrong, and inputs inside the training range do not make a forecast accurate.

outside_tested_reasons: meal size outside the tested 20-120 g
twin_curve.caveat: Research estimate, not the served forecast. Fitted on synthetic training patients, selected on validation patients and tested once on held-out synthetic patients against simulator ground truth; the simulator's near-linear meal response favours it. The walk effect is cohort level (the twin has no personal activity parameter) and reflects the simulator's built-in exercise model. Not evidence about real patients; not advice.

result.disclaimer: Simulated what-if scenario. The hypothetical meal was never added to the patient record. Differences are learned associations of the forecasting models, not causal physiological effects. Not medical advice and not a treatment recommendation.

prediction.rationale: Qualitative flag, NOT a probability of hypoglycaemia. Lower bound first below 70 mg/dL at +90 min (lowest 56 mg/dL at +120 min). Record lists glucose-lowering medication that can cause hypoglycaemia: Glimepiride (sulfonylurea).

note.text: Interoperability prototype: deterministic FHIR R4 export of a synthetic patient. Not certified, not profiled against ABDM/NRCeS guides, not a compliance claim, not for clinical use.

summary.note: Synthetic CGM. Descriptive summary following the 2019 international consensus metrics; GMI is an estimate from mean glucose, not a laboratory HbA1c. Not a diagnosis.
